name: General Store
desc1: A tall, lanky lad stands at your approach. He is clad in a bright
desc2: assortment of flamboyant clothes, and he sports a pair of shiny golden
desc3: earrings. He bows, smiling, and gestures to the items displayed in the
desc4: store. There is an opening into a room to the east, and you can exit
desc5: onto a broad street to the north.
